---
title: "speciesPlot"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)

#file path
folder <- "../../../Lana/2024_12_29_17_15/OEE-data-clusters"

files <- list.files(
  folder,
  pattern = "^SummaryIndividuals_\\d+_with_clusters.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

out_dir <- file.path("../cluster_html/")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)


checkpoints <- as.integer(sub(
  "^SummaryIndividuals_(\\d+)_with_clusters\\.csv$", "\\1",
  basename(files)
))

data_list <- map2(files, checkpoints, ~{
  df <- read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE)
  df$checkpoint <- .y
  df
})

world <- bind_rows(data_list)

#colour map
cluster_col_map <- c(
  "1"  = "#66c2a5",
  "2"  = "#fc8d62",
  "3"  = "#8da0cb",
  "4"  = "#e78ac3",
  "5"  = "#a6d854",
  "6"  = "#ffd92f",
  "7"  = "#e5c494",
  "8"  = "#b3b3b3",
  "9"  = "#1f78b4",
  "10" = "#33a02c",
  "11" = "#fb9a99",
  "12" = "#cab2d6",
  "13" = "#fdbf6f",
  "14" = "#b15928",
  "15" = "#BDBDBD",
  "16" = "#6a3d9a",
  "17" = "#ff7f00"
)


species_names <- c(
  "Tolsim-Mammoth",
  "Tolsim-Velociraptor",
  "Tolsim-Dugong",
  "Tolsim-Rabbit",
  "Tolsim-Mouse",
  "Tolsim-Baobab",
  "Tolsim-Crab",
  "Tolsim-Jellyfish",
  "Tolsim-Birds",
  "Tolsim-Centipede",
  "Tolsim-Dragonfly",
  "Neo-LUCA",
  "Tolsim-Bacteria",
  "Tolsim-Fungi",
  "Outlier",
  "Tolsim-Pillbug"
)

world$species_name <- species_names[world$cluster_id]

noise_col <- "#BDBDBD"


unique_cps <- sort(unique(world$checkpoint))

for (cp in unique_cps) {
  df_cp <- world %>% filter(checkpoint == cp)
  if (!nrow(df_cp)) next

  df_cp <- df_cp %>% sample_frac(0.05)

  #mapping
  df_cp <- df_cp %>%
    mutate(
      cluster_hex = cluster_col_map[as.character(cluster_id)],
      cluster_hex = ifelse(is.na(cluster_hex), noise_col, cluster_hex)
    )
  

  # colour assignment
  p <- plot_ly(
    data = df_cp,
    x = ~maxEnergy,
    y = ~pgmDeath,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    marker = list(
      size = 4,
      opacity = 0.8,
      color = df_cp$cluster_hex   
    ),
    text = ~paste(
      "Species: ", species_name),  #adjust the displayed text here
    hoverinfo = "text",
    showlegend = FALSE
  )

  p <- layout(
    p,
    xaxis = list(title = "maxEnergy"),
    yaxis = list(title = "pgmDeath"),
    title = list(text = paste("Checkpoint", cp),font = list(size = 13))
  )

  saveWidget(
    p,
    file = file.path(out_dir, sprintf("clusters_cp_%s.html", cp)),
    selfcontained = TRUE
  )
}


```
